added_failures_note: The reviewed run carries no baseline_suite or after_suite arms in its manifest, so there is no base/head pair to take a set difference over and no added failure id can be derived. The run is a measurement node that changes no product source, and the two files it adds are imported by nothing, so the zero is a measured absence of a suite arm rather than a clean base/head delta; it is recorded as zero with no ids and is not evidence of a green suite.

findings.text: The ledger JSON is written once, at the last statement of main(), so a run that is stopped before the end writes nothing at all; both measurement jobs (1304001 and 1304021) were cancelled DUE TO TIME LIMIT after their present-route solve and before this line, so docs/research/forward-solve-memory-ledger/ exists on disk and is empty and git ls-tree a51678ba2 shows no ledger committed, which loses the array census, the memory_analysis, the serialized executable size and the operand-cache inventory the done-when names; the repository already solves this exact hazard in benchmarks/compile_host_memory.py, whose docstring states it persists a part receipt as each rung lands so an out-of-memory kill loses one rung rather than the run.

The done-when asks for the HLO constant BYTES and the probe records text.count("constant("), a count of literal sites rather than their byte size, so the one quantity that would say how much of the lowering is embedded weights is recorded as a number that cannot answer it.

The seven owner rows in the section 3 table sum to 12.41 GB (9.58 + 0.68 + 0.47 + 0.69 + 0.77 + 0.21 + 0.010), not the 12.48 GB and 98.2 % the text states, which is 97.7 % of the 12.705 GB peak, and the run's own manifest records 96.25 % for the same quantity, so one headline attribution number is carried three ways in two artefacts, none of them matching the table beside it.

The bank attempt passes plasma_to_grid (1089 x 1089) as the rows argument and plasma_to_wall[:, :1] as exterior, but SupportOperands.rows is shaped (nodes, source cells, three moments, six jet entries) as its docstring at nova/equilibrium/support_read.py:48 states, so the call cannot succeed even against a geometry that carries sample_points and the AttributeError it records at :410 is only the first of two independent mismatches; the doc's conclusion at :78 is correct on the types, but this call does not distinguish a type refusal from the probe's own operand misuse.

jax_memory() carries a dead `try: pass / except Exception: pass` block left from an earlier draft, which reads as a silently skipped check whose condition was removed and which no reader can distinguish from one that was meant to run.

The done-when asks for one figure, a stacked bar of the two routes' peak memory by owner, and the section 2 and section 3 tables stand with no figure beside them anywhere in docs/research/forward-solve-memory-ledger.html; the manifest records this under outside_scope as docs/figures lying outside the fence, which is honest about the site convention but leaves the deliverable short.

host_rss() re-derives the peak-resident helper benchmarks/compile_host_memory.py:77 already owns as _rusage_peak, and the surrounding receipt fields (executable size, HLO counts, memory analysis, one rung per subprocess) restate that module's mechanism without importing it, so a node measuring memory now has two instruments and the newer one lacks the durable part receipt the older one documents.
